text.p: Typhoon Fern is becoming a high risk to shipping west of Guam at this time. It should track towards the northern Mariana islands this period with top winds reaching 100 mph at that time. Rough seas and heavy rain squalls along its path will continue to impact shipping through the period. The northern Mariana islands may see heavy rains and flooding later in this period with possible wind and property damage as well.

Tropical cyclone Fergus will be a significant risk to shipping as it tracks from just southeast of the Solomon islands to just west of the Vanuatu islands during the next 36-48 hours. No major islands are directly affected but several smaller islands may see gusty winds and heavy rain.
Tropical depression Greg is only a minor risk to shipping east of Sabah Malaysia this period. It is expected to weaken and dissipate by 24-36 hours.

Tropical cyclone 12p is no longer a significant risk to shipping in the Gulf of Carpentaria as it has made landfall over the North Territory. It is moving further inland at this time. It may lead to some locally flooding in this area during this time. TC 12P will likey cross over into the Timor Sea and reintensify by 24-36 hours, once again becoming a threat to shipping operations.
